reviews.t: My favorite scrub in the world was Trader Joe's Grapefruit scrub
reviews.x: My favorite scrub in the world was Trader Joe's Grapefruit scrub...which they discontinued (the Lavender scent is a good second choice). But I missed the grapefruit scent, so I ordered this. First of all, for the price, it's way too little product. Second, not enough oil to keep the scrub mixed in. When I opened the jar, a lot of the scrub tried to escape and float away. (I now store the jar upside down, which seems to help). But finally, the grapefruit scent is super wimpy. Will not reorder.
